documents.title: ECEn Policy for the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Coursework
documents.stance_why: The ECEn policy is the default when an instructor is silent. It values AI skills but bans it when asked not to, on closed-book work, and where it circumvents learning, while allowing listed uses with citation. Narrow listed permissions plus bans: restrict (instructors may supersede).
documents.summary: ECEn default AI policy for all ECEn and IT&C classes unless the instructor provides exceptions. It states guiding principles, bans AI on closed-book work and where it circumvents learning, requires citation for open-book work, lists appropriate uses (brainstorming, syntax, overviews, project content), and leaves penalties to the instructor.

units.why: States professional experience with AI is 'essential' while noting AI in some contexts 'can undermine educational goals and intellectual growth': a balanced rationale, coded as professional skill rationale P44; the learning-risk half is covered by the later principle.
